text:
maria: Quick Q — I'm debugging p95 latency spikes for acme on the eu-gen route. Where's the saved log search / dashboard for org=acme model=gen-xl env=prod? want logs + kv_cache misses if possible.

devon: Try the saved preset under Observability -> Presets. I think there's already one for acme gen-xl. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/search?id=acme-eu-genxl-ops 

maria: thanks — can you paste the actual query so I can run it locally (and save a copy)?

devon: sure, paste this into LogSearch: 
```
org:acme AND model:gen-xl AND route:eu-gen AND env:prod
| parse_json message as m
| m.status as status, m.latency_ms as latency_ms, m.kv_cache_miss as kv_cache_miss
| where status >= 500 OR status == 429
| stats p95(latency_ms) by bin(1m) as minute, route
```

li: FWIW the naming convention we use is `ops/<region>/<org>-<model>-p95-5xx` so you can find related ones quickly. The current preset is named `ops/eu/acme-genxl-p95-5xx`.

maria: can someone add kv_cache_miss to the alert condition? current alert fires on short-lived 429s and floods PagerDuty.

sam: Suggestion: loosen the p95 alert to p95>1500ms for 10m and add an additional condition `AND kv_cache_miss == true` to reduce noise. Alternatively keep current alert and add a secondary alert for kv_cache_miss rate > 5%.

ops-bot: index-mapping update: `kv_cache_miss` field deployed as boolean across prod indices at 10:14 UTC — will be available to queries.

devon: I'll update the saved search to include `kv_cache_miss` in the view and add the suggested alert snippet to the playbook. Pushing now, will post new URL. :thumbsup:

maria: awesome, thanks. Please also add the saved search link to the ACME runbook under Investigations -> eu-gen.

devon: done. New saved search: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/search?id=abcd1234. Added to runbook: https://redwood.gitbook.io/playbooks/acme/investigations (section "eu-gen latency").

maria: verified the query reproduces the spike and shows kv_cache_miss=true on most 5xx events. I'll follow up with the team to tune the cache settings. Thanks all :raised_hands:

li: quick note — if you want to pin this search for the oncall rotation, use the star menu in the top-right so it's in the Ops dashboard.

devon: starred and added to dashboard `Ops / EU Gen` :eyes:

maria: closing this thread — will open a follow-up if we need changes to autoscaling or routing.
